notes.title: Latest Playtest for Turn Based Carnival
notes.content:
It's the Turn Based Carnival and Bounce Castle is featured as an upcoming release! To celebrate we're released a brand new playtest build for you all to try!

Wishlist Bounce Castle on Steam and get instant access to the playtest! Try out the Forest region and see if you can defeat the new Region Boss, the Knight!

notes.title: Bounce Castle Public Playtest and Streams
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting News: Bounce Castle Public Playtesting Event 🏰

We're thrilled to announce a fantastic opportunity for you to be among the first to explore the whimsical world of Bounce Castle – a captivating physics and strategy game that will challenge your wit and test your skills like never before. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey through a kingdom of bouncy mushrooms, spikey logs and strategic challenges that will keep you on your toes!

Bounce Castle is ready for public playtesting! We need all of your feedback and bug identifying abilities. Your feedback and insights are invaluable to us, and we can't wait to hear what you think. Help us shape the future of Bounce Castle by sharing your thoughts, ideas, and any issues you encounter during the playtesting event. So give the playtest a try and provide all the feedback you've got on our Discord server! Link can be found in game.

Watch the Live Streams: Tune in to our streamers as they tackle Bounce Castle live, sharing their gameplay experiences, strategies, and reactions. Don't miss this chance to see the game in action and get a taste of the adventure that awaits you!  Join us at 4pm EST on Thursday, Oct. 19th to see Alieann as she tries to make her way through the dangerous (and possibly buggy) Forest of Bounce Castle!

We'll also have other streams periodically throughout the weekend with the developers and others. Check back to see more!
